dedupe_keys.name: natural hazards research summit 2022 influence of subsurface spatial variability on ground deformations in earthquakes

description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2022: Influence of Subsurface Spatial Variability on Ground Deformations in Earthquakes is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Patrick Bassal, Ohio State University (osu.edu). Earthquake ground deformations at sites with interlayered soil deposits are often over-predicted by common simplified procedures. A system-level workflow that integrates detailed subsurface modeling with two-dimensional (2D) nonlinear dynamic analyses (NDAs) is used to re-evaluate the spatial extent and magnitude of deformations at three well documented post-earthquake case history sites. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fsb1-8857. Keywords: Geostatistics; Spatial Variability; Site Investigations; Soil Dynamics; Liquefaction; Cyclic Softening; Lateral Spreading; Numerical Modeling; Case Studies. Published 2023-03-09. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
